Zach Bates produced a blistering lap to top qualifying at Mount Panorama on Friday. (Getty Images: Robert Cianflone)

The Top 10 Shootout, which sets the first five rows of the grid for the Bathurst 1000, will be held this afternoon.

Zach Bates will be the last driver on Mount Panorama after topping Friday's qualifying session.

ABC Sport will have a live blog of the Bathurst 1000 from lights out to the chequered flag on Sunday, October 11.

Zach Bates will be hoping to back-up his record breaking efforts from yesterday as he goes into Saturday's Top 10 Shootout as the favourite to secure pole position.

Brodie Kostecki will also be in the shootout trying to set a new Bathurst 1000 record for most consecutive pole positions for the Great Race.

Here is what you need to know ahead of this afternoon's shootout.

The 10 fastest duos from Friday's qualifying session will hit the mountain this afternoon for a shot at pole position in Sunday's Bathurst 1000.

Here is when the shootout begins in your state or territory.

Here are the results of yesterday's qualifying session which was topped by Zach Bates with a 2:03.938, the fastest time set in the current era of Supercars at Bathurst.

Brodie Kostecki was fifth fastest on Friday and keeps alive his chance of becoming the first driver to secure four consecutive pole positions for the Bathurst 1000.

The entry of Cooper Murray/Lochie Dalton has been strong throughout the opening two days, with Murray third fastest yesterday. Murray was fighting for the win in the final laps of last year's Bathurst 1000.

The 10 fastest duos from Friday's qualifying session have one lap to get their car onto pole.

Each team will select one driver to complete the lap. The 10th fastest team on Friday will go first, then the ninth fastest, and so on.

Each team gets one lap and the top 10 positions on the starting grid will be determined by these single laps.
